sources.title: Mary Barra on GM's EV strategy, autonomous driving, and crisis leadership
sources.quote_checked: I don't want you running the company for the quarter. I want you running it for the long term. | Problems don't get smaller. Rarely do problems get smaller. | When's the best time to solve a problem? ... The minute you know you have one. | Agility is a superpower now.

sources.title: GM CEO Mary Barra on the EV sales "end game"
sources.quote_checked: We still think EVs are the end game. | I don't think it's shifted our mission.

sources.title: Barra struggles to sell lawmakers on today's GM
sources.quote_checked: Today's GM will do the right thing. | Our customers and their safety is at the center of everything we do.

sources.title: Internal probe decries GM's "incompetence and neglect"
sources.quote_checked: a pattern of incompetence and neglect | there was no demonstrated sense of urgency
